messages.subject: returning a NULL datatable
parts: Similary to rCharts, renderDataTable() in shiny v8 does not work with a NULL object or a NULL dataset (NULL or data.frame(NULL)). Can we expect that will work in the future ?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: returning a NULL datatable
parts:
What do you expect to see in this case? renderDataTable() will just
return nothing, if you use shiny 0.8, which is on CRAN now (the
binaries are still being built, though): install.packages('shiny',
type='source', repos='http://cran.r-project.org')

Regards,

messages.author: 9e1d805a26f6d719
messages.subject: Re: returning a NULL datatable
parts:
Just a note that with Shiny 0.8.0, sending a NULL data.frame to a DataTable works as expected -- nothing is displayed. But sending a 0-row data.frame gives a weird popup error message on the web browser, which is not ideal. The workaround is just to replace a 0-row DF on the server with NULL, but I think it'd be better for the DataTable to display the headers with no rows, rather than give a message.

Otherwise, DataTable is brilliant. :)

 -Harlan
